segments.name: Nuclear & Safety
products: radiation protection, measurement and monitoring solutions
segments.description: Supplies radiation detection, measurement, monitoring and analysis products, software and services to nuclear power plants, laboratories, research facilities, defense and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Our Nuclear & Safety segment powers advancements in nuclear energy and critical radiation safety, measurement and analysis applications across nuclear power facilities, laboratories, research and other industrial markets such as defense.

segments.name: Medical
segments.description: Provides radiation oncology quality assurance, dosimetry and radionuclide therapy products and services to hospitals, cancer centers, diagnostic imaging and radiation therapy facilities.
segments.evidence: Our Medical segment improves the quality and safety of cancer care delivery and supports applications across medical diagnostics and practitioner safety.

revenueModel.text: Customers including nuclear power plants, government agencies, laboratories, hospitals and cancer centers pay for radiation detection, measurement, monitoring and medical quality assurance products, software and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products, software and services are sold directly and indirectly to a variety of end-use customers.

changes.text: In 2024 the company renamed its Technologies segment as Nuclear & Safety.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company renamed its Technologies segment as "Nuclear & Safety.
